Detailed

This corner of the relativity site has probably the largest collection
of Einstein's writings on relativity that you'll find anywhere
on the internet (typed out by yours truly), including 

<fanfare of trumpets>

Einstein's Relativity book!
. 

(This part of the website is probably now well overdue for another 
reorganisation. Rats.)

These pages don't attempt to deal with Einstein's work on quantum 
theory, or to produce proper biographical picture of Einstein the 
person - they just try to provide a one-stop source for as much of 
his relativity material as possible. 

Don't try loading the two 
Nature
 articles - these two pages  
will stay blanked out until I've done more checks on their includability. 

WHAT'S HERE:

- Biographical 
(26-01-97)
 

Brief biography
 - to provide a
sense of timescale and a context for the various Einstein texts

- 
 Einstein's Relativity book in HTML format! 

(01-12-98)
 

Relativity: 
The Special and the General Theory, with additional comments 
and explanatory notes
 
- Finally, by popular demand! 
If you find the SR sections a bit tedious, skip 
section I (SR) and go on to the rest of the book. 
I still intend to do 
a bit more work on these pages (improving cross-linking and 
navigation), but the essentials are here.

- indexes for other texts on-site

Most
 of the major Einstein relativity texts are still available
in print. I've transcribed quite a few of them and put them onto
this site (some are complete, some are only extracts). Most are
here in HTML format (with or without greek text), and a couple
of the books are here in Windows "helpfile" format.
The pieces are listed and cross-indexed in a number of ways ...

by Book
 - there are a few compilations
available, with a fair amount of overlap

by Date
 - lists the pieces in date
order, with links to the compilations that contain each piece

Detailed
 - as above, but with some
brief descriptions of what the pieces actually are

 All texts transcribed from non-electronic sources.
